page.overview:
Who is Benito Mussolini?

was the fascist Prime Minister of Italy from 1922 to 1943.

Mussolini appears seated with Adolf Hitler and German Air Marshal Hermann Göring in Grampa's flashback.

Homer makes gestures reminiscent of Mussolini when presented to an Italian village.
